title: IIR Halfband Interpolator
text: Interpolate signal using polyphase IIR halfband filter, 4 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Filter specification} sets Filter design parameters Transition width and stopband; {Transition width (Hz)} sets the transition width 4.1e3, {Filter order} sets the order of the IIR halfband filter, {Stopband attenuation (dB)} sets the minimum attenuation needed in stopband, {Design method}, {Internal allpass structure} sets the filter structure in coefficient mode Minimum, {Make the first branch a pure delay}, {Delay length in samples for branch 1} sets the length of the delay, {Specify coefficients from input port}, {Branch 1 allpass polynomial coefficients} sets the allpass polynomial filter coefficients of first branch, {Branch 2 allpass polynomial coefficients} sets the allpass polynomial filter coefficients of second branch, {Branch 1 Wave Digital coefficients} sets the allpass filter coefficients of first branch in wave digital filter form, {Branch 2 Wave Digital coefficients} sets the allpass filter coefficients of second branch in wave digital filter form, {Last section of branch 2 is first order} sets the make the last section of the second branch as first, {Input highpass subband}, {Sample rate mode} sets the mode to specify the input sample rate Use normalized, {Input sample rate (Hz)} sets the sample rate of input signal, {View Filter Response} and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run Interpreted. Values come from the instance.
